messages:
lina: Quick idea: add 'profiles' to the deploy bot to group common flags (pins, canary, windows, notes). Could reduce one-off mistakes.
carter: Sounds useful. How's a profile different from the param bank folks have been discussing?
jess: profile = human-friendly composed preset + description. param bank could be lower-level; profiles reference params + extra metadata (owner, risk).
lina: Exactly. Profiles would be the UI/CLI-level thing that product folks pick. Example: 'promo-safe' profile = {pin, canary=0.05, rollback_policy, owner=@growth, allowed_windows}.
ops_lead: Two requirements: 1) profiles must require an explicit owner/approval to go to prod 2) profiles that target >25% traffic must require a pin.
carter: For rollback policy, propose fields: enabled, mode (auto/manual), metrics = [error_rate,p99], thresholds = {error_delta_pct:3, p99_ms:200}, cooloff_mins.
jess: Add a 'stagger' option for slow ramping: stages like 5%->25%->100% with durations. Helpful for infra-sensitive services.
infra-bot: note: we already have rollout scheduler hooks; can wire profile windows into calendar-based gating.
lina: UX sketch: `/deploy profile create promo-safe --spec '{"pin":"svc@sha:123","canary":0.05,"stages":[{"pct":5,"mins":10},{"pct":25,"mins":20}],"rollback":{"enabled":true,"mode":"auto","error_delta_pct":3}}'`
carter: Nice. We should also support `/deploy profile preview <name>` that prints the rollout timeline and checks requirement rules.
ops_lead: preview must include a safety score and highlight missing pin or missing owner approval. Also a link to the audit log where profile edits are recorded.
jess: Implementation note: store profiles in k/v with versioning. Profiles should be immutable once approved; new edits create a new version and require re-approval.
infra-bot: CI suggestion: when a profile is created, run policy-lint against a set of guardrails (no canary>0.5, pins required for >25%, change_window inside business-hours unless owner allows).
lina: How about a quick abort flow: when auto-rollback fires, bot posts `@ops_lead rollback triggered by profile promo-safe (reason: error_delta 4.2% > 3%)` with buttons `UNDO AUTO-ROLLBACK`, `HOLD AND ESCALATE`, `MARK AS MANUAL`. Clicking UNDO requires 2 approvals.
ops_lead: Yes. Also log the decision and keep a chain-of-custody record for compliance.
carter: Testing approach: create a simulated runner that replays metrics and runs the profile's stages. AJ/CI can add a unit test harness.
jess: I'll add a `--simulate` flag to the preview that accepts a metrics series and shows what would've happened (useful for oncall training).
nina: small nit: naming consistency. call CLI subcommands `profile save`, `profile list`, `profile apply`, `profile preview`, `profile lint`, `profile abort`.
infra-bot: ack: scheduling integration notes saved to backlog ticket INF-482.
release-helper: if profiles include a `notes` field, I can auto-draft the release note and attach profile metadata (owner, stages, risk).
lina: Action items: 1) jess to write RFC for profile schema + lifecycle, 2) carter to prototype preview simulation, 3) infra-bot to add lint rules in CI, 4) ops to define approval workflow.
carter: I'll prototype this week and post a branch link.
ops_lead: We'll review thresholds and approval cadence in next weekly release meeting.
lina: Great, thanks. If no objections I'll open RFC and a small spike PR to add profile save/list/apply.
carter: No objections here. :thumbsup:
release-helper: FYI: when landing, please include migration plan for existing ad-hoc flags to profiles so we don't break past deploy scripts.
